newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 20.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 20.

text.p: -- News Corp Ltd and Tele-Communications Inc are nearing a deal to buy 40 percent of the sports programming services of Cablevision Systems Corp for about $850 million, the Wall Street Journal said. On the New York Stock Exchange, News Corp closed at 18-5/8 Thursday. TCI ended at 16-7/8 while Cablevision closed at 48-7/8.

-- CPC International Inc said it would take two pretax charges totalling $328 million in the second quarter related to the spinoff of its corn refining operations and the restructuring of its packaged food operations. The stock closed at 86-1/2.

-- Gateway 2000 Inc said it agreed to acquire Advanced Logic Research Inc for about $194 million in a move to expand into the corporate market. Gateway closed at 33-1/8 while Advanced Logic closed at 14-1/8.

-- Ikon Office Solutions Inc said its net earnings for the third and fourth quarters would be below analysts' estimates. It said it expected to earn $0.30 to $0.32 per share in the third quarter, compared to a First Call consensus estimate of $0.40. The stock closed at 32, then slid to 27-1/2 after the bell.
